Lonke udumo lungoluka Allah, Lona owembulela iNcwadi esigqileni saKhe futhi akayenzanga yaba indida.
Uyenze yaqonda, ukuze [isigqila saKhe] sixwayise ngesijeziso esinzima esivela kuYe siphinde sethule izindaba ezimnandi kulabo abakholwayo abenza izenzo ezinhle ukuthi bayothola umvuzo omuhle [iJana].
Bayohlala kuwo unaphakade.
Siphinde sixwayise labo abathi u Allah uziqokele ingane.
Abanalo ulwazi ngaYe [u Allah] bona nokhokho babo. Anzima [impela] amazwi aphuma emlonyeni yabo, impela bahubha aluhlaza.
Hleze uyazikhandla uzikhathaza emuva kokuba bengafuni ukukholela kulamazwi [eKurani].
Impela senze lokhu okuphezu komhlaba kwaba umhlobiso wawo ukuze sibavivinye ukuthi ubani kubo oyokwenza izenzo ezinhle.
Futhi siyokwenza konke lokhu okungaphezu kwawo kube wumhlabathi ongamili lutho.
Ingabe ucabanga ukuthi abantu basemgedeni noqwembe yibona ababesimangaliso ezibonakalisweni zeThu na?
Mhla amabhungu eyokhosela emgedeni, athi: “Nkosi yethu siphe umusa ovela kuWe futhi usenzele izinto zethu zibe nobuqotho”.
Savala izindlebe zabo iminyaka eminingi besemgedeni.
Sase siyabavusa ukuze sazi ukuthi iliphi iqembu kwambili elibale kahle isikhathi abasihlala.
Thina sikulandisela indaba yabo ngeqiniso. Nebala babengamabhungu ayekholelwa eNkosini yabo futhi sabandisela ukukhanya.
Saqinisa izinhliziyo zabo mhla bema bathi: “iNkosi yethu, iNkosi yamazulu nomhlaba, asisoze sakhonza nasinye isikhonzwa ngaphandle kwaYo; phela siyobe sesikhulume iphuta impela.

Abantu bakithi laba, baziqokele izikhonzwa ngaphandle kwaYo [iNkosi yethu]; mabalethe phela ubufakazi obusobala obuzifakazelayo [lezikhonzwa]. Kumbe ukhona ophambuke kunalowo oqambela u Allah amanga na?
Lapho niziqhelelanisa nabo kanye nalokho abakukhonzayo ngaphandle kuka Allah, hambani niyokhosela emgedeni; iNkosi yenu iyonipha emseni waYo iphinde inilungisele lokho eningaphila ngakho.

Ububona ngelanga lapho liphuma likekela liya ngakwesokudla lomgede wabo nalapho liyoshona libashiya ngakwesobunxele kulapho babesendaweni evulekile kuwo [umgede]. Lokho ezinye zezibonakaliso zika Allah. Lowo u Allah amholayo, usendleleni eqondile kepha lowo amdukisile awusoze wamtholela umhlengi oyomkhalima.

Ubuzocabanga ukuthi babhekile [abalele] kulapho bebelele. Futhi sasibaphendulela ngakwesokudla nangakwesobunxele, kanti nenja yabo yayindlale imilenze yayo yangaphambili emnyango. Uma ubungababona ubuyobalekela udle phansi ngejubane ugcwele ukubesaba.

Sabeke sesibavusa ukuze babuzane bodwa. Wathi omunye wabo: “Nihlale isikhathi esingakanani na?”. Bathi: “Sihlale usuku noma ingxenye yosuku”. Bathi: “iNkosi yenu iYona eyazi kahle ngesikhathi enisihlalile, ngakhoke thumelani omunye wenu ngalemali yenu aye edolobhini asibhekele ukuthi ikuphi ukudla okumsulwa bese enilethela eningakudla kukho, abe nesineke [nomthengisi] angatsheli muntu noyedwa ngani”.
Ngokuba uma benganibona bayonikhanda ngamatshe noma banibuyisele enkolweni yabo bese ningaphinde niphumelele unaphakade.

Kanjalo sabenza batholakala ukuze [abantu] bazi ukuthi isithembiso sika Allah siyiqiniso nokuthi iSikhathi [sokwahlulela] akunakungabaza ngaso. Mhla bephikisana ngendaba yabo, bathi: “Yakhani isakhiwo phezu kwabo [emgedeni], iNkosi eyazi kahle ngabo”. Bathi labo ababenamandla okunquma odabeni lwabo: “Sizokwakha iMasijidi pheze kwabo”.

Bayothi: “Bebethathu bebane ngenja yabo”. Abanye bayothi: “Babehlanu beyisithuba ngenja yabo”, beqagela. Abanye bayothi: “Babeyisikhombisa beyishagalombili ngenja yabo”. Yithi: “iNKosi yami iyazi kahle ngenani labo, futhi akekho abalaziyo ngaphandle nje kwedlanzana”. Ngakhoke ungalokhu uphikisana ngabo ngaphandle uma kokuphikisana okusobala futhi ungabuzi muntu ngabo [abomgede] kubo [abeMibhalo].
Futhi ungabothi ngento: “Nebala ngizoyenza kusasa”.
Ngaphandle kokuthi: “Uma u Allah evuma”. Futhi ukhumbule iNkosi yakho uma ukhohlwa, bese uthi: “Hleze iNkosi yami ingiholele kokucacile kunalokhu ngokuhola”.
Bahlala emgedeni wabo iminyaka engamakhulu amathathu base bengeza neyisishagalolunye.

Yithi: “U Allah wazi kahle ngesikhathi abasihlala, phela okungabonwayo emazulwini nasemhlabeni kungokwaKhe. Yeka ukubona kwaKhe nokuzwa kwaKhe [okungenamhawulo]. Futhi abanaye omunye uMhlengi ngaphandle kwaKhe kanjalo akanaye noyedwa umlingani ekunqumeni kwaKhe”.
Balandisele lokho okwembulelwe kuwe [Muhamadi] eNcwadni yeNkosi yakho. Akekho ongaguqula Amazwi aKhe futhi awuso wathola esinye isiphephelo ngaphandle kwaKe.

Zibandakanye nalabo abakhuleka eNkosini yabo ekuseni nakusihlwa belangezelele Ubuso baYo. Ungabuki abanye ngaphandle kwabo ngokulangazelela ubukhazikhazi bempilo yasemhlabeni. Futhi ungamlaleli lowo esenze inhliziyo yakhe yangaba nendaba nokusikhumbula waphinde walandela izinkanuko zakhe futhi indaba yakhe kwaba ukuduka nje.

Yithi: “Iqiniso livela eNkosini yenu; ngakhoke othandawo makakholwe futhi othandayo angakholwa”. Impela abaphambukile sibalungiselele uMlilo abayohaqwa imithangala yawo. Uma becela amanzi, bayonikwa amanzi afana namafutha abilayo ashisa ubuso. Saze sasibi isiphuzo futhi yaze yayimbi indawo yokuhlala.
Nebala labo abakholwayo futhi benze nokuhle, impela Thina asiwuchithi umvuzo walowo owenza izenzo ezinhle.

Labo bayothola izivande zaphakade okugeleza ezansi kwazo imifula, bayohlotshiswa kuzo ngamabhengela egolide baphinde bembathe izembatho eziluhlaza zesiliki ecolisekile nengugqinsi. Kuzo bayohlala baqhiyame emibhedeni. Waze wamuhle umvuzo futhi yaze yayinhle indawo yokuhlala.
Benzele umzekelo wamadoda amabili, enye yawo, sayinika izivande ezimbili zomvini sazizungeza ngamasundu kwathi phakathi kwazo zombili zafaka ezinye izitshalo.
Zombili lezivande zazithela izithelo zazo zingagodli lutho sanhlobo. Sagelezisa umfula phakathi kwazo zombili.
Futhi wanezinye izithelo, wabe esethi kuzakwabo ekhuluma ebhekise kuye: “Mina nginomcebo nezingane eziningi kunawe”.
Wangena esivandeni sakhe kulapho esephambukile wathi: “Angicabangi ukuthi lokhu kuyoke kubhubha impela”.
Futhi angicabangi ukuthi iSikhathi [sokwahlulelwa] siyoke sifike. Kantike uma ngizobuyela eNkosini yami ngiyothola okungcono esikhundleni sakho.
Uzakwabo wathi, naye ekhuluma ebhekise kuye: “Ingabe awukholelwa kulowo owakudala ngomhlabathi kanjalo nangesidoda wabe esekwenza indoda na?”
Kepha Yena ungu Allah iNkosi yami futhi angibhangqi lutho neNkosi yami.
Ngabe uthe uma ungena esivandeni sakho wathi: “Kwenzela ngentando ka Allah, awekho amandla okwenza okuhle ngaphandle kuka Allah”, nakuba ungibona mina nginomcebo nezingane ezincane kunawe.
Mhlawumbe kungekudala iNkosiyami iyongipha okungcono kunesivande sakho aphinde asithumele ngesijeziso esivela ezulwini, siphenduke inhlabathi eshelelayo.
Noma amanzi aso azike ungasakwazi ukuwathola.

Izithelo zakhe zahaqwa [isijeziso esashaqa konke]. Wachaya izandla ebalisa ngakho akuchitha kuso [isivande], kulapho sona siwe phansi nemipheme yaso. Wathi: “Hawu, ngifisa ukuba angizange ngibhangqe lutho neNkosi yami”.
Futhi kwakungekho qembu ebelingamsiza ngaphandle kuka Allah, kwayena akakwazanga ukuzisiza.
Kulaphoke ukulawula kuka Allah Oyiqiniso. NguYena onomuvuzo ongcono nonesiphetho esingcono [kwabakholelwa kuYe].
Futhi benzele umzekelo wempilo yasemhlabeni, njengamanzi emvula esiwehlisayo bese ehlangana nezitshalo zomhlaba [zibe luhlaza]. Ziyobe seziyoma zipheshulwa imimoya. U Allah akehlulwa yilutho.
Umcebo nezingane ziwubukhazikhazi bempilo yasemhlabeni. Kanti ke izenzo ezinhle yizona ezinomvuzo ongcono eNkosini yakho nesifiso esingcono.
Ngosuku lapho siyosiphula khona izintaba uyobona umhlaba unqunu [ungesitshalo ungenasakhiwo] futhi siyobabuthanisa bonke ngothi lwabo akukho noyedwa esiyomshiya.
Bayoma phambi kweNkosi yakho imigqa ngemigqa. [Bese yithi]: “Nize kithi njengoba sanidala okokuqala. Empeleni bekade niqhakambisa ukuthi asisoze sanibekela isikhathi sokuhlangana.

Iyobe isiyabekwa incwadi [isiqhophi sezenzo]. Uyobona ngezigilamkhuba sezigcwele itwetwe ngekuqukethe bese bathi: “Kwaze kwaphela ngathi, yini indaba ngalencwadi ayishiyi lutho okuncane nokukhulu ikuqukethe konke”. Bayothola konke abakwenzile kukhona futhi iNkosi yakho ayikaze yenze okungebulungiswa nakoyedwa nje.

Futhi khumbula mhla sithi kuzingelosi: “Khothamelani u Adamu niwe ngobuso”. Zakhothama zawa ngobuso ngaphandle kuka Ibhilisi owabe eyijini owaqoma ukungawuthobeli umyalelo weNkosi yakhe. Ingabe nenza yena kanye nabalandeli bakhe abahlengi ngaphandle kwaMi kulapho bona beyizitha kini na? Kwaze kwakubi lokho abaphambukile abakuqokile.
Angizange ngibabonise ukudalwa kwamazulu nomhlaba nokudalwa kwabo uqobo [babengekho] futhi angisoze ngaqoka abadukisi ukuba babe ngabalekeleli.

Futhi balandise ngoSuku lapho eyothi [u Allah]: “Bizanike abalingani baMi laba phela ebenibaqhakambisa”. Bayobe sebeyababiza kepha bangabaphenduli futhi sifaka phakathi kwabo [eJahanamu] indawo yembubhiso.
Izigilamkhuba ziyobona uMlilo; ziqiniseke ukuthi ziyongena kuwo futhi akukho la abangawubalekela khona.
Impela sibacacisele abantu kule Kurani ngayo yonke imizekelo. Kepha umuntu uthanda ukuqophisana ukudla zonke izinto [ezidaliwe].
Ayikho into evimba abantu ukuba bakholwe lapho kufika kubo ukukhanya nokuthi bacele intethelelo eNkosini yabo ngaphandle kokuthi behlelwe okwehlela abasendulo noma behlelwe isijeziso bekhekile.

Futhi sithumela iZithunywa ukuba zibe abethuli bezindaba ezinhle nabexwayisi nje kuphela. Labo abangakholwa baphikisa besebenzisa umbhedo bezama ukushabalalisa ngawo iqiniso. Belu bathatha izibonakaliso zeThu nalokho abaxwayise ngakho njengehlaya.

Ngubani ophambuke ukudla lowo owelulekwa ngemibiko yeNkosi yakhe kepha yena ayishaye indiva, akhohlwe nayimisebenzi yezandla zakhe. Impela sifake isisithezo ezinhlizweni ekutheni bayiqonde [iKurani], nasezindlebeni zabo bayizimumu. Noma ungababizela endleleni eqondile abasoze bayilandela nhlobo.

Futhi iNkosi yakho Ingumthetheleli Onesihawu, ukube nje ubenganijezisa ngakho konke enikwenzayo, impela beyoshesha anijezise. Kepha [abaphambukile] banesikhathi ababekelwe sona abasoze baphunyuka kuso.
Lezo imizi [izindawo], abantu bakhona sababhubhisa lapho benza ukuphambuka futhi sabeka isikhathi sokubabhubhisa.
Futhi khumbula mhla uMusa ethi kunceku yakhe: “Angeke ngiphumule kuze kube ngifika lapho kuhlangana khona izilwandle ezimbili noma ngihambe ibanga elide”.
Kuthe lapho bobabili befika lapho kuhlangana khona izilwandle ezimbili bakhohlwa inhlanzi yabo, yona eyavele yangena olwandle kwaqhekeka indlela yayo.
Kuthe sebendlulile [kuleyondawo] wathi [uMusa] kunceku yakhe: [Ake usiphe idlamini [isidlo sasemini] yethu, impela uhambo lwethu lolu lusikhathazile”.
Yathi: “Uyakhumbula ngenkathi siphula edwaleni, ngikhohliwe ukukwazisa ngenhlanzi futhi nguShayitani kuphela ongenze ngiyikhohlwe ukuyibalula. Ingene olwandle kwavuleka indlela yayo ngesimanga.
Wathi: “Yilokho ebesikufuna”. Babuyela emuva lapho abahambe khona.
Bazithela phezu kwesigqila sezinye izigqila zeThu esasinika umusa ovela kithi saphinde sasifundisa ulwazi luvela kithi.
Wathi uMusa: “Ngingahamba nawe yini ukuze ungifundise okunye kwalokho ofundiswe kona okuholela eqinisweni na?”
Sathi [isigqila sika Allah]: “Impela angeke wena ukhone ukungibekezelela”.
Belu ungakubekezelela kanjani lokho ongenalwazi lwakho na?
Wathi [uMusa]: “Uzongifumanisa - ngemvumo ka Allah – ngingobekezelayo futhi angeke ngephule umyalelo wakho”.
Sathi [isigqila sika Allah]: “Uma uzohamba nami, ungangibuzi ngalutho kuze kube yimi engiphawulayo ngakho”.
Bahambake bobabili baze bayogibela emkhunjini, sawubhoboza. Wathi [uMusa]: “Uyawubhoboza ukuze ucwilise abakuwo na? Impela wenze into embi”.
Sathi: “Angishongo yini ukuthi impela angeke wena ukhone ukungibekezelela”.
Wathi: “Ungangijezisi ngosebengikukhohliwe futhi ungangenzeli izinto zami zibe nzima”.
Bahambake bobabili baze bahlangana nomfana, sambulala. Wathi [uMusa]: “Ubulala umphefumulo omsulwa ongabulalanga muntu? Impela wenze into eshaqisayo.
Sathi: “ Angishongo yini kuwe ukuthi impela angeke wena ukhone ukungibekezelela”.
Wathi: “Uma ngiphinde ngakubuza noma yini emuva kwalokhu ungabe usahamba nami, impela sekuphele wona amazaba lapha kimi”.

Baqhubeka bahamba bobabili baze bazithela phezu komuzi. Base becela ukudla kubantu bakhona kepha benqaba ukubamukela njengezihambi. Base bethola kuwo [lomuzi] uthango obeselutshekile lufuna ukuwa, saluvusa salumisa. Wathi [uMusa]: “Uma uthanda ungabakhokhisa ngalo inzuzo”.
Sathi [isigqila sika Allah]: “Yikhona ke la mina nawe esihlukana khona. Ngizokwazisa ngencazelo yakho konke lokhu ohluleke ukukubekezelela”.
Mayelana nomkhumbi, ubungowezichaka ezazisebenza olwandle, bengifuna ukuwufaka isici ngamabomu, ngokuba ngaphambi kwabo bekunenkosi ehlwitha imikhumbi [engenacisi] ngodli.
Mayelana nomfana, abazali bakhe bebengabakholwayo sase sisaba ukuthi uyobahlukumeza [lapho esemdala] ngokungezwa nokungakholwa.
Besifuna ukuthi iNkosi yabo ibaphe ongcono esikhundle sakhe noyobaphatha kahle.

Mayelana nothango, belungelezintandane zabafana ababili khona emzini, kanti ngaphansi kwalo bekunomcebo wabo bobabili futhi abazali babo babeqotho, ngakhoke iNkosi yakho beyifuna ukuba bakhule babe badala bese bekhipha memba umcebo wabo; isihawu esivela eNkosini yakho. Angikwenzanga ngokwentando yami. Leyo iyona incazelo yakho konke lokhu ongakhonanga ukukubekezelela.
Futhi bakubuza ngo Dulikarinani [umpondombili]. Yithi: “Ngizonilandisa ngendaba yakhe”.
Impela sambeka emhlabeni samnika indlela yokufinyelela kuyo yonke into [ulwazi lokuyenza].
Wabe eselandela enye yezindlela.
Waze wafika entshonalanga, walithola lishonela esiyalweni esimnyama, wathola kunabantu lapho [entshonalanga]. Sathi: “We Dulikarinani, ungabajezisa noma ube nesihle kubo”.
Wathi: “Lowo ophambukile sizomjezisa bese ebuyela eNkosini yakhe iphinde imjezise isijeziso esishaqisayo”.
Kuthi lowo okholwayo owenza nezenzo eziqotho, uyothola umvuzo weJana, futhi siyokhuluma kahle naye.
Waphinda walendela enye yezindlela.
Waze wafika empumalanga, walithola liphumela phezu kwabantu esingezange sibenzele isisithezo esibavikela kulo.
Belu besinayo yonke imininingwane ngakwenzayo.
Waphinda walandela enye yezindlela.
Waze wafika phakathi kwezintaba ezimbili ezazihonqile, wathola emuva kwazo zombili kunabantu abangaqondi lwimi [olunye].
Bathi: “Dulikarinani, impela isizwe sakwa Ya’ajuju nakwaMa’ajuju benza umonakalo ezweni. Kunganjani sikukhokhele ukuba usakhele uthango phakathi kwethu nabo.
Wathi: “Lokhu engikunikwe iNkosi yami kungcono, ngakhoke ngisizeni ningilethe abantu abanamandla ukuze ngakhe phakathi kwenu nabo uthango.

Ngipheni ingqukuqa yensimbi. Kuthe lapho esezivale zombili izinhlangothi zentaba [ngezisimbi], wathi: “Vuthelani [...basani umlilo ushise izinsimbi]”. Kuthe lapho eselenze lawumlilo luvutha [uthango], wathi: “Ngiletheleni ithusi ngiligalele ngaphezu kwalo [uthango lovuthayo].
Abazange bakhone [abakwaYa’ajuju nakwaMa’ajuju] ukuleqa [uthango] futhi abakhonanga ulibhoboza imbobo.
Wathi: “Lona umusa ovela ku Allah. Kepha uma sekufike isethembiso seNkosi yami uyolenza [uthango] lube uthuli. Ngokuba isithembiso seNkosi yami siyiqiniso.
Ngalolosuku siyobadedela abanye babo balakanyelane nabanye. Kuyothi lapho sekushaywa icilongo [okwesibili] sibabuthanise bonke ndawonye.
NgaloloSuku siyovezela obala iJahanamu kulabo abangakholwa.
Labo amehlo abo ayemboziwe engayiboni imibiko yaMi futhi bengakwazi ukuzwa lutho.
Ingabe laba abangakholwa bacabanga ukuthi bangenza izingqila zaMi abahlengi [babo] ngaphandle kwaMi na? Impela iJahanamu siyilungiselele labo abangakholwa ukuba bahlale kuyo.
Yithi: “Kunganjani nginitshele ngalabo ozenzo zabo azinanzuzo”.
Yilabo imisebenzi yabo empilweni yasemhlabeni yayisekudukeni kulapho bona becabanga ukuthi benza kahle.
Labo, yibona kanye abangayikholwanga imibiko yeNkosi yabo nokuthi bayohlangana naYo. Ngakhoke imivuzo yezenzo zabo yashabalala nangoSuku lokwahlulela asikuba nandaba nabo.
Labo umvuzo wabo iJahanamu ngenxa yokungakholwa kwabo nokwenza imibiko yaMi neZithunywa zaMi inhlekisa.
Nebala labo abakholwayo baphinde benze izenzo eziqotho, bayothola izivande zeFiridosi njengendawo yokuhlala.
Bayohlala kuzo unaphakade, abayikufuna ukususwa kuzo.
Yithi: “Ukube ulwandle beluwuketshezi lokuloba Amazwi eNkosi yami; beluphela ulwandle engakapheli Amazwi eNkosi yami, noma singaletha olunye [ulwandle] ukugcwalisela”.

Yithi: “Mina ngingumuntu nje kuphela, kwembulelwe kimi ukuthi lowo okumele nimkhonze uyedwa vo kuphela. Ngakhoke lowo ofisa ukuhlangana neNkosi yakhe makenze izenzo eziqotho [ezinhle] angabhangqi noyedwa ekukhonzeni iNkosi yakhe”.
